dest:tennant-creek:header.why: Weak: Lake Mary Ann footbridge near Tennant Creek, 3:2 landscape, subject centred. Not a town panorama; no town cityscape found.
Weak: ute on the Bill Allen Lookout road above Tennant Creek, red-earth outback. Vehicle is the focus; not a town panorama.

dest:kakadu-national-park:why4.why: Alt text "Cahills Crossing crocodile": a saltwater crocodile leaping at the crossing. PORTRAIT 2000x3000, so a 1.6:1 crop is 2000x1250 and the croc fills the frame (animal is the subject; the crossing barely visible).

Alt: visitors on the viewing platform beside the river crossing. Shows the place itself (use if the reason is reworded, e.g. "Watch the tide at Cahills Crossing" / "See the East Alligator River crossing"). 1600x1200.

dest:arnhem-land:header.why: Alt: 4WD parked on a hill looking out on Bawaka homeland: rocky islet, beach and sea under blue sky, 3:2 ground-level landscape (vehicle at left edge; subject mid-frame).
Alt: scenic view of a beach in Arnhem Land: red rocks and turquoise water. 3000x2437 (1.23:1); drone-high but oblique, not a pure aerial.
Bawaka homelands beach with rocky islet, 3:2, a person small in the frame.
Macassan Beach: rock shelf, surf and beach, 3:2 ground-level.

dest:arnhem-land:why1.why: Visitors viewing large Yolngu-style bark paintings with an Aboriginal man pointing, in a gallery. Alt only says "Arnhem Land"; the Yirrkala art centre is the usual such venue but not named; verify. 4928x3280.
Alt "Buku-Larrnggay Mulka Centre": the Yirrkala art centre, two women browsing prints (prints rather than bark paintings). 5315x3543.
Buku-Larrnggay Mulka printmaking studio at Yirrkala, 1503x1000; printing rather than bark.

dest:arnhem-land:why2.why: Rainbow Cliffs (Banambarrnga): red-ochre cliff over a curved beach and clear water, ground level, 1333x1000 (4:3). Cliff in the upper-left third.
Rainbow Cliff beach with red cliff at right and rock platform, 1800x1100 (1.64:1), converted from webp. Cliff is at the right edge, so needs a subject point (x~0.85).

dest:arnhem-land:why3.why: East Woody Beach/Island at sunset: tidal sand flat and the island across it, 1333x1000. Shows the island and the flats but not a clear spit to walk.
The sandspit curving out to East Woody Island under cloud, the best match to the reason, but only 1000x667 (below the 1280 minimum). Ask the operator for the original.

dest:katherine:header.why: Katherine River at the low-level crossing at dusk, 1200x576 (below 1500, aspect 2.1). Not a town panorama.
Banner: Nitmiluk (Katherine) Gorge with a cruise boat at sunset, 3837x2196 (1.75:1). A stand-in for the town (gorge is 30 km away); offered only as the area's signature landscape.
Katherine River gorge at sunset with a cyclist in the foreground; area landscape, not the town.

dest:katherine:why2.why: Katherine Museum building frontage (old homestead-style), 3060x2035; shows the place itself.

dest:katherine:why2.why: Old petrol pumps and machinery outdoors at the museum, 5472x3648; outback history.
The old aerodrome terminal building that is now the museum, 3000x1955 (not a clear exterior of the building; coastal/outback).
